_about: The single source of truth for the course's order, task types, checklists, projects and lesson metadata (course/curriculum.md §5 restates it; course/build.py fails if the two drift). Lesson numbers never change once shipped: saved quiz answers are keyed by them, and by option position, so a translation keeps the option order. A lesson's text is course/lessons/<id>.md; a lesson without a file is planned, not shown. English since 31 Oct 2026 (Yarin: "i want the course fully in english"); the Hebrew first version is in _to-delete/course/lessons-he/. Each project's check is what Claude looks for when Yarin hands it in; attach names the saved data sent along with it (links: this week's link log and tag values; numbers: the last saved weeks).

fade.label: The checklist is folded: one tap opens it
Write your own steps first, then compare

types.name: Carousel
checklist: Open Carousel Machine on the Mac
Choose the day's option: a best-selling book's topic, a strong hook on slide 1, a clear comment word
Grade it 1 to 5 with a one-sentence reason
Approve the picture, or ask for a fix with a note
Check the "How it will look" preview: at most 10 slides, the comment word on the last slide and in the caption, no brand name or web address before the last slide, a separate Facebook post
Schedule it in the Postiz block, at 06:00

types.name: Messages
types.where: Instagram on the phone, and the link maker here
checklist: Open the post's comments and find who wrote the comment word
Make a tagged link in the link maker, for the post's topic
Send a DM with the link
Count in the link log how many DMs went out
Follow up once, a day later, with anyone who did not reply

types.name: Live moment
types.where: Instagram, on the phone or the Mac
checklist: Write in one sentence what the moment is and why it matters to parents right now
Check: is it tied to a buying moment (a gift, a milestone, a holiday)? Is it sad or political?
Pick a fast format: a story, a trend reel or an extra post
If there is a link, make it in the link maker
Add a post; never replace one that is already scheduled
Set a reminder to compare after a week

types.name: Reel
types.where: The reel editor through Claude, and Instagram
checklist: Write the first-second hook, the text at the top
Ask Claude for the edit: hook, captions, and trial versions if needed
Check on the phone: the text is inside the safe zone, no mention of AI
If the call to action is the bio link, make sure it is tagged
On Sunday, write down views, saves and shares

types.name: Creators
types.where: The creator map on the Mac
checklist: Open the creator map on the Mac
Check that the creator passes the admission bar
Send the message: a personal link with a discount for their audience, never a "discount code"
Update the status and write a note
Set a follow-up reminder

types.name: Numbers
types.where: The Numbers tab here, Instagram, and what Yossi sends
checklist: Open this week's Numbers tab
From Instagram: how many comments with the comment word, and for the best post its saves, shares and reach
From the link log: how many DMs with a tagged link went out
Tagged orders: from the source Yossi gives, or "Not available yet"
Write one sentence: what these numbers can't prove

types.name: Yossi
checklist: Write in one sentence what you need
Why: what it changes for sales or for your pay
The exact change you are asking for
How you will know it worked: the number before
Send it, then mark the task Done. It is done even without an answer

projects.text: Choose your tag values, then make every DM link this week in the link maker and log it
projects.check: The utm_medium value Yarin chose is named and is neither creator nor paid-social. The attached link log shows this week's DM links made in the link maker, each with utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign and utm_content, and a count of DMs sent with it. A week with no logged links, or links with no DMs counted, is a redo.

projects.text: Your first Numbers tab, with "Not available yet" where that is true
projects.check: A saved week on the Numbers tab. DMs with a tagged link and comment words are filled in (they are always countable); tagged clicks and tagged orders are numbers or honestly marked Not available yet. The can't-prove sentence names something specific these numbers cannot show, not a generic disclaimer.

projects.text: Write to Yossi which tag values are yours, and ask for a way to see tagged orders and for the A21 fix
projects.check: The message to Yossi: says in one sentence what is needed; names the utm_medium value that marks Yarin's links; asks for a way to see the orders that carry it; asks for the A21 fix (keep the tag for 30 days instead of losing it when the tab closes, research/cro-crm/audit.md A21); asks to write down the share of orders with a tag before the change. It counts as done when sent, answered or not.

projects.text: One live-moment post: choose it, make it, tag it, and compare after a week
projects.check: Names the moment and why it matters to parents now; says why it passed fit and safety (tied to a buying moment, not sad or political); the fast format used; the tagged link if there was one; and the comparison a week later against a usual post, or the date it is due.

projects.text: The Hanukkah creator round, by 10 Nov
projects.check: Which creators were messaged and that each passes the admission bar; the offer is a personal link with a discount for their audience, never a discount code; each creator's status and follow-up date.

projects.text: A weekly read: Meta against the store, and a paragraph on what can't be proven
projects.check: Meta's purchase count and the store's for the same week, the gap between them named with a reason the two counts differ, and a paragraph on what these numbers cannot prove.

projects.text: Ask Yossi for one store fix, with the number before
projects.check: One store fix asked of Yossi: the exact change, why it should move tagged sales, and the number before the change, so the result can be compared.

Decision for December first. Then what happened in November with the real counts (tagged clicks, DMs with a tagged link, comment words, tagged orders or Not available yet), and what these numbers cannot prove. Short enough to read in two minutes. It must not credit a single post or reel with sales it cannot be shown to have caused.
